create_ModularPointCloudOptimizer: create a ModularPointCloudOptimizer instance to optimize a global scene with freezeable partial poses and intrinsics
preset_pose_ModularPointCloudOptimizer: preset known camera poses on the ModularPointCloudOptimizer to fix specific image poses during optimization
preset_intrinsics_ModularPointCloudOptim: preset known camera intrinsics matrices on the ModularPointCloudOptimizer to fix focal length and principal point
get_pts3d_ModularPointCloudOptimizer: get the 3D point maps for all images by converting depth maps through camera poses and intrinsics
get_intrinsics_ModularPointCloudOptimize: get the reconstructed 3x3 camera intrinsics matrices for all images from the optimizer
